title: Giants RB Najee Harris expected to see more time against Saints following Cam Skattebo fumbles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants RB Najee Harris expected to see more time against Saints following Cam Skattebo fumbles
sources.description: The Giants will give running back Najee Harris a more prominent role against the New Orleans Saints following Cam Skattebo's costly fumble in Week 5, according to ESPN's Jordan Raanan.
